sets.relationshipLabel: complementary fastener halves, side by side
sets.explanation: Each pair is the two halves of a single closure that only work when joined together.

sets.relationshipLabel: opposite alterations to a garment dimension
sets.explanation: Each pair names two opposite tailoring moves along the same axis of a garment: width or length.

sets.relationshipLabel: thing built to stop the damage it guards against
sets.explanation: Each first item exists specifically to prevent the exact damage named by its partner.

sets.relationshipLabel: document that dictates the finished garment
sets.explanation: Each first item is the specification that a maker follows to produce the exact garment named second.

glossary.definition: The tightly finished edge along the side of a woven fabric, running parallel to its length.

definitions.definition: A little curved piece of metal that catches onto something to hold a garment closed.
A small loop of metal that something else catches onto to keep a garment shut.
A small round fastener sewn onto fabric that slots through cloth to hold things closed.
A small slit cut into fabric just big enough for a fastener to pass through.
To make a piece of clothing wider or looser by adjusting its seams.
To make a piece of clothing narrower or tighter by adjusting its seams.
To make a piece of clothing longer than it currently is.
To make a piece of clothing shorter than it currently is.
A small hard cap worn on a fingertip to protect it while pushing a needle through cloth.
A tiny sharp poke or puncture, the kind a needle or pin leaves behind.
The tightly finished edge along the side of a woven fabric, running parallel to its length.
The unraveling of threads at a cut or worn edge of fabric.
A paper template with shapes and markings used to cut fabric pieces for a garment.
An outer garment with sleeves that covers the upper body, often worn open at the front.
The exact numbers describing someone's body size, used to fit clothing precisely.
A suit made completely from scratch to fit one specific person's body and taste.
